cues.text: Hello, Brian Parks speaking.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Oh hello, I’m calling about the advert in the paper ...
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: For the car?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Er, yes, the Mini you’ve got advertised for sale.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Oh yes?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: I just wanted to find out a bit more information.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Of course, what would you like to know?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: It’s my brother who’s interested actually ... but he’s not in today so he asked me to call you.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Fine ...
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Great, thanks. So it’s a Mini ...
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Yep.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: ... and how old is it?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Just coming up to thirteen years old.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: And I seem to remember from the ad that it’s grey?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: That’s it ... doesn’t show the dirt!
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Absolutely ... anyway the colour shouldn’t be a problem for Jeff, you know, the important thing is the quality ...
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Yes, of course.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: And what about mileage ... with it being pretty old it’s probably over a hundred thousand?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Actually it’s forty thousand less than that ... sixty-two thousand on the clock!
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Great! I remember now ... I’m confusing it with another ad I was looking at.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Right ... pleasant surprise then.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Yeah. Have you been the only owner ... or was there a previous one ... ?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: I’m the second one. Before it was owned by a teacher ... who was a very careful driver - didn’t have any accidents.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Very good. And what about you ... what do you tend to use it for?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: I haven’t used it all that much ... mostly for shopping ... you know the sort of thing.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: So not much wear and tear. I’ll make a note of that. I know Jeff wanted me to check that.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Right.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Now about the price, I see you’ve got it down as one thousand, two hundred and fifty pounds. I’m not sure Jeff’ll be able to come up with that amount.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: In the ad I did say one thousand, two hundred and fifty or nearest offer ...
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: So would you be prepared to go down to one thousand?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: That’s really too low, I’m afraid.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: One thousand, one hundred?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: I might be able to go to that.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: OK I’ll make a note of that. What about tax? Is it due soon?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Got another five months before it’s due ...
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Oh, that’s a real plus, yes. I’ll make a note of that ...
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: OK.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Now, you say it’s in good condition.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: For its age, I’d say yes, definitely. It’s just been serviced and there were no major problems.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Major ... ?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: I’d be able to show you the service report. The only thing is you’d have to get a new tyre in the near future ... though it’s still OK, you know, it’s certainly absolutely safe, at the moment.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: OK, fair enough. Yes, I understand.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: And the garage also mentioned that one headlight could probably do with replacing - they think there’s a fault there, you know, intermittent ...
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Well, we’d obviously look at all the documents ... but that sounds very straightforward.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Of course. I’ve got all the service documents up-to-date and you can look at those.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Well, it all sounds pretty good and I know my brother will be interested. So, would it be possible for him to see the car ... he’s back from his trip tomorrow ... and away tonight, so how about tomorrow?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: ... tomorrow ... Wednesday? I’m afraid that’s not possible. I’m out pretty much all day.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Well, Thursday then?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: That’d be fine, yeah.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: In the morning?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Yes, that’d suit me perfectly.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Great.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Now, you’ll need my address.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Oh yes, of course! What is it?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: It’s number two hundred and thirty-eight,
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Two-three-eight ...
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: London Road.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Oh that’s easy enough!
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Yes, very straightforward.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: So I’ll pass on these notes to Jeff and he’ll see you in a couple ...
cues.speaker: Woman
